title: Understanding Modern Lightbulbs: Lumens, Color Temperature, and Efficiency
summary: The video briefly outlines how lighting has evolved from simple incandescent bulbs to more efficient technologies (halogen, fluorescent, and LED). It emphasizes that selecting a bulb involves more than wattage: light output is measured in lumens, and color temperature affects how the light looks indoors. The speaker notes that modern bulbs can provide similar lumen output with less electricity, but at a higher upfront cost, while offering longer lifespans.
